Question
========
Why should quality checks be integrated throughout the data lifecycle?

Answerlist
----------
* when automated, it helps saving money
* early attention to data quality is more efficient
* to avoid using automated tools, as it reduces the risk of errors
* to train new employees to handle company's data


Solution
========
Quality checks should be integrated throughout the data lifecycle because early attention to data quality is more efficient.
